faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Faculty positions at Nagaland University?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Guest Faculty positions at Nagaland University is 08-09-2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech/B.E degree along with an M.Tech or PhD in Computer Science & Engineering to be eligible for the Guest Faculty positions.

faq.question: Q3. How will the candidates be selected for the Guest Faculty roles?
faq.answer: The selection process details are not explicitly mentioned in the provided data. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for comprehensive information on the selection procedure.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary structure for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: For PhD holders, the salary is ₹1,500/- per lecture up to ₹50,000/- per month. For M.Tech holders, it is ₹1000/- per lecture up to ₹25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for the Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their resumes and supporting documents to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the official website of Nagaland University?
faq.answer: The official website of Nagaland University is www.nagalanduniversity.ac.in. Candidates can visit this site for more information and updates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Guest Faculty recruitment at Nagaland University is NO.NU/SET/CSE/OP/1B1/2021-925.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The Guest Faculty positions at Nagaland University are on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is Nagaland University located?
faq.answer: Nagaland University is located in Kohima, Nagaland, with the pincode 797004.
